items.text: Adults 21 and over may possess up to 3 ounces of cannabis and 24 g of concentrate, and use it in a private home or most places tobacco smoking is allowed, but not in vehicles, businesses, restaurants (including patios), hookah or cigar bars, federal property, or most public and state parks and beaches. 'Gifting' alongside a sale is illegal; home growing isn't yet allowed for adult use.

laws.rule: Adults 21 and over may possess up to 3 ounces of cannabis and 24 g of concentrate, and use it in a private home or most places tobacco may be smoked, but not in vehicles (even parked), restaurants including patios, businesses, hookah or cigar bars, most public and state parks, or beaches. Taking cannabis across state lines is illegal. Cannabis remains illegal under US federal law, including on federal land such as national parks.

New York generally prohibits possessing a handgun, short-barrelled rifle or shotgun, or assault weapon outside your home or business without a New York licence, and New York City has its own separate licensing. Out-of-state permits are not a substitute.
